canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Seni Iveran: 39-year-old woman, 174 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: wide triangular face; close-set eyes and a high arched brow; prominent bridge, compact mouth; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: offset gathered mass. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; a shaped cloth clasp; a dense freckle field. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
